name: Brave Saint (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
It’s easy to laugh in the face of death when you believe in the certain and unavoidable victory of your god. The brave saint spreads the word by winning duels, achieving amazing deeds and swaying the hearts and minds of infidels with her wits and grace.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A brave saint is proficient with light armor and bucklers. This alters the inquisitor’s armor proficiencies.

Saint’s Finesse (Ex)

At 1st level, a brave saint gains the benefits of the Weapon Finesse feat with light or one-handed piercing melee weapons and with the favored weapon of her deity, and she can use Wisdom in place of Intelligence for the purpose of combat feats prerequisites. This ability counts as having the Weapon Finesse feat for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites.

This replaces stern gaze.

Panache (Ex)

At 2nd level, the brave saint gains panache as a swashbuckler of her same level. She regains panache through critical hits and killing blows when using her deity’s favored weapon, in addition to when using a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon. If the brave saint has the panache ability from another class or archetype as well, the panache points from the two sources do not stack, but the brave saint regains panache in any way either class feature allows her to. For example, a character with a Charisma score of 16 who has both the brave saint’s and the swashbuckler’s panache has a base of 3 panache points and regains panache from critical hits and killing blows from both her deity’s favored weapon and light or one-handed piercing melee weapons.

This replaces track.

Deeds

At 5th level, the brave saint gains the dodging panache and menacing swordplay swashbuckler deeds, as well as the following:

Sacred Dare (Ex)

The brave saint can spend 1 panache point when she makes a Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, Perception, Sense Motive, or Stealth check to roll 1d6 and add the result to the check. She can do this after she makes the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, she rolls another 1d6 and adds it to the check. She can continue to do this as long as she rolls natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to her Dexterity modifier (minimum 1).

The brave saint treats her deity’s favored weapon as a light or one-handed piercing weapon for the purpose of using her deeds.

This replaces bane.

Advanced Deeds

At 12th level, a brave saint gains the targeted strike swashbuckler deed, as well as the following:

Stunning Wit (Ex)

The brave saint amazes both friends and foes with her knowledge of scriptures and audacious interpretation of canonical law. Weaving sacred citations in her swordplay as if they were verses of poetry, she can spend 1 panache point to stun for 1 round an enemy she hits who fails a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the brave saint’s level + her Wisdom modifier).

At 14th level, the brave saint gains the perfect thrust and swashbuckler’s edge deeds. She applies swashbuckler’s edge’s effects to the same skills used in sacred dare.

This replaces greater bane and exploit weakness.
